name: Speed learning (Howard Berg)
label: Speed learning
block: Upload one of the Howard Berg session recordings and spend 15 minutes working through it with Learny to do the 16-minute drill more effectively. Later sessions: ongoing speed-learning practice built with Learny.

name: Backflip on land
label: Backflip
block: You can already backflip on a trampoline. First 15 minutes: look at MOTIVE School of Movement's flipping/tricking classes and adult (13+) open gym, sign the online waiver, and call 864-775-4844 to enroll. Later sessions: land-backflip progressions.

name: Finish the Napoleon book by Oct 20
label: Napoleon book
block: Read the next chunk of the Napoleon Bonaparte book. Deadline: October 20.

name: Swap houses with Nina for a weekend
label: House swap w/ Nina
block: Plan it: pick a weekend, write house rules/notes for each other, and plan a few fun surprises to leave at each place.

name: "And I Love Her" (Beatles) on guitar
label: And I Love Her
block: Take one short section of the tab. Work out which finger plays each note and drill the transition into the next part slowly until it's smooth.

name: Moonlight Sonata 3rd mvt. arpeggios at full speed
label: Moonlight arpeggios
block: Metronome speed-building: short fast bursts, small BPM bumps, play soft and even.

links.title: Taubman approach to the Presto agitato (tonebase)

name: See a play at The Logos Theatre
label: Logos play
block: Check what's showing at The Logos Theatre in Taylors, pick a date (maybe with Nina), and get tickets.

name: Hold a handstand for a long time
label: Handstand
block: Wrist prep, then wall handstand holds (time them), then line/balance drills. Progress toward freestanding holds.
